exposure.description: The CVEs that mark the pair vulnerable. Rejected CVEs count only with include_rejected. critical, high, medium and low count by severity, from CVSS v3, else v4, else v2. A CVE of severity NONE or UNKNOWN counts only in total_cves.

total_cves.description: CVEs that mark the pair vulnerable.

max_cvss.description: Highest CVSS v3 base score. null if no CVE has one above 0.

avg_cvss.description: Mean of the CVSS v3 base scores above 0. null if no CVE has one above 0.

max_epss.description: Highest EPSS score, 0-1. null if no CVE is scored.

poc_backed_count.description: CVEs for which cve_risk_score gives has_public_poc true.

worst_risk_score.description: Highest risk score, 0-100. 0.0 when total_cves is 0.

most_recent_published.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the newest CVE. null when total_cves is 0.

product_filter_note.description: Always present: an exact name match can miss CVEs.

risk_score.description: 0-100, from CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and public exploit signals.

label.description: CRITICAL at 90+, HIGH at 70+, MEDIUM at 40+, else LOW.

top_cves.description: At most 10 CVEs, highest risk score first.

eol.description: Support dates from endoflife.date. null when the pair maps to no endoflife.date product. Then the dates are unknown. It does not mean the product is supported.

product.description: The endoflife.date name of the product.

cycle.description: The one release cycle that the version argument, or a versioned product name such as windows_10_22h2, picks. null when none or more than one is picked.

eol_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. null if the cycle has no date.

is_eol.description: true when eol_date is today or earlier. Without an eol_date, endoflife.date's own flag.

eol_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. null if the cycle has no date.

is_eol.description: true when eol_date is today or earlier. Without an eol_date, endoflife.date's own flag.

cycle_variants.description: The release cycles picked when there are two or more, such as the editions of one release. null otherwise.

eol_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. null if the cycle has no date.

maintained_cycles.description: At most 10 cycles endoflife.date marks maintained, newest release first.

maintained_cycles_truncated.description: true when more cycles are maintained than listed.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.
